title: Sales documents

hint.quotation: Prices you have offered a customer. When they accept, a sales order is made from the quotation.
hint.order: What customers have ordered. Confirm an order, then deliver it to make the invoice and take the stock out.
hint.invoice: What customers owe you for goods you delivered. Open one to take a payment, print it or take goods back.
hint.receipt: Money customers have paid. A payment settles their invoices; what is left stays on their account until used or given back.
hint.refund: Money given back to customers from what they paid in advance.

formHint.quotation: Choose the customer and the goods. Prices and tax are worked out when you save.
formHint.order: Choose the customer and the goods. Prices and tax are worked out when you save; nothing leaves stock until you deliver.
formHint.invoice: Invoice a customer and deliver the goods now: the stock leaves and the amount is added to what they owe.

noneHint.quotation: Make a quotation to offer a customer your prices.
noneHint.order: Accept a quotation or make an order directly for a customer.
noneHint.invoice: Invoice a customer, or deliver a sales order. Credit sales made at a till appear here too.
noneHint.receipt: Record a payment from a customer's page or from an invoice.
noneHint.refund: A refund gives back money a customer paid in advance. Start one with New refund.

noMatch.order: No sales order matches these filters.

needsCustomersHint: Quotations, orders and invoices are made for a customer. Turn on Customers, then come back.
validUntilHint: Leave empty for 14 days from today.
termsHint: Leave empty to use the customer's terms.
deliverFromHint: The store the goods are taken from. An invoice or delivery needs one.
invoiceStockNote: Issuing the invoice takes the goods out of stock at once. Products that are tracked by batch are better delivered from a sales order.
priceReasonHint: Needed when a price other than the list price, or a discount, is entered.
linesHint: Leave the price empty to use the customer's list price. The saved document shows the exact prices, tax and total.
linesHintNoPrice: Prices come from the customer's price list. Changing a price needs the price override permission.
notFound: This document could not be opened

draftNote.quotation: This is a draft. Send it to the customer, or accept it if they have already agreed.
draftNote.order: This is a draft. Confirm the order when it is ready to be delivered.

pendingApprovalNote: This order is waiting for someone to approve it. Once approved it can be delivered.
expiredNote: This quotation passed its valid-until date. Make a new one for the customer.

send.title: Mark {{number}} as sent?
send.quotation: Use this once the quotation has gone to the customer. It can no longer be changed after this.

accept.title: Accept {{number}}?
accept.quotation: The customer agreed. A sales order is made from this quotation with the same goods and prices. Nothing is delivered yet.

submit.title: Confirm {{number}}?
submit.order: The order can then be delivered. It cannot be changed after this, and a larger order may wait for someone to approve it first.

cancel.title: Cancel {{number}}?
cancel.quotation: The quotation is closed and cannot be accepted any more.
cancel.order: The order is closed. An order that has been partly delivered cannot be cancelled.

deliverHint: Everything still to deliver is filled in. Lower a quantity to deliver part of the order now and the rest later.
deliverNote: Delivering takes the goods out of stock and makes an invoice at the agreed prices.
cancelInvoiceAsk: Only an invoice with no payment and no returns can be cancelled. The goods go back into stock and the customer no longer owes the amount.
overdueNote: This invoice was due on {{date}} and is still not paid in full.
creditSaleNote: This invoice came from a sale on credit at a till. To undo it, void the sale or take the goods back against the sale.
openingNote: This is an opening balance brought in when the business started. It has no goods of its own.
returnPaidHint: This invoice is paid, so the customer is refunded in cash or mobile money, or you can choose an exchange.
returnUnpaidHint: While the invoice is owed, a credit note reduces what the customer owes (up to the amount owed). Money goes back only once it is paid.
settledNone: It did not pay any invoice.
settledNoneHint: The whole amount is held on the customer's account.
cannotReverseRefunded: Part of this payment was given back as a refund. Reverse the refund first to reverse the payment.
reverseReceiptAsk: Use this if the payment was recorded wrongly or the money did not arrive. The invoices it paid are owed again.
applyAsk: Use the {{held}} held on this customer's account to pay their unpaid invoices, oldest first. No money moves.
appliedNone: There was nothing to apply: the customer has no unpaid invoices.
refundHint: {{held}} of this payment is held on the customer's account and can be given back.
cashRefundNote: A cash refund comes out of your open till, so open a till first.
newRefundHint: Choose the customer, then the payment to give money back from. Only payments that still hold money on account are listed.
nothingHeldHint: This customer has no money held on account.
reverseRefundAsk: Use this if the money did not actually go back. The customer holds it on account again.

rejections.title: Offline rejections
rejections.hint: Sales and till actions made offline that the server could not accept. Nothing is lost: each is kept here whole.
rejections.readOnly: These are read-only. The till keeps the sale and sends it again; once the cause is fixed (for example a product, a closed day or a stopped till), it goes through and shows as resolved. Copy the details if someone needs to look into it.
rejections.noneOpen: No sale is waiting for attention.
rejections.noneHint: Sales made on a till without a connection appear here only if they were refused when sent.
rejections.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text instead.
rejections.whatNext: What now: read the reason, fix the cause, and let the till send again. If the sale cannot be accepted at all, record it by hand from the details above and tell the cashier.

restockDefault: The store the goods left from
